note: Sample feed. Dates are stored as offsets from launch day so the calendar is never stale. Venue coordinates are approximate.

events.name: Green Mountain Soul Revue
events.summary: Six-piece Burlington soul outfit running through Stax and Motown deep cuts, with a horn section that does not quit.

events.name: Waterfront Farmers Market
events.summary: Seventy-plus vendors along the lake — produce, cider donuts, maple everything, and live fiddle near the north end.

events.name: Flynn Presents: Chamber Series
events.summary: String quartet program of Dvořák and Florence Price in the Flynn's main hall.

venue.name: Flynn Center for the Performing Arts

events.name: Church Street Buskers Festival
events.summary: Street performers take over the Marketplace all afternoon — jugglers, a one-man band, and a contortionist by the Kiss the Cook window.

events.name: Late Set at Nectar's
events.summary: The room that launched Phish. Local jam bands, gravy fries until 2am.

events.name: Lost Nation Theater: New Works Night
events.summary: Staged readings of three short plays by Vermont writers, with a talkback after.

events.name: Statehouse Lawn Summer Concert
events.summary: Brass band on the capitol lawn. Bring a blanket; the hill fills up by six.

events.name: Capital City Cider Tasting
events.summary: Eight Vermont cideries pouring flights, with a cheese pairing table from a Cabot affiliate.

events.name: Winooski River Cleanup
events.summary: Volunteer morning along the riverbank. Gloves and bags provided, coffee at the trailhead.

events.name: Spruce Peak: Bluegrass on the Mountain
events.summary: Outdoor amphitheater set with the ridgeline behind the stage. Gates at five.

events.name: Trapp Family Lodge Meadow Run
events.summary: 5k across the meadow trails, finishing at the bierhall. Registration includes a lager.

events.name: Recreation Path Sunset Walk
events.summary: Guided naturalist walk on the 5.3-mile greenway along the West Branch.

events.name: Stowe Family Field Day
events.summary: Sack races, a bounce maze, and a fire truck the kids can climb on.

events.name: Lebanon Opera House: Folk Double Bill
events.summary: Two touring songwriters trading sets in a 1924 hall with famously good acoustics.

events.name: Colburn Park Concert Series
events.summary: Free Thursday concerts on the green through the summer. Food trucks on School Street.

events.name: Upper Valley Maker Fair
events.summary: Sixty makers — woodworkers, letterpress printers, a guy who builds cedar canoes by hand.

events.name: Hopkins Center: Dance Ensemble
events.summary: Dartmouth's resident company premieres a new piece scored by a student composer.

events.name: Dartmouth Green Farmers Market
events.summary: Wednesday market on the Green — Upper Valley farms, bread from Norwich, cut flowers.

events.name: Connecticut River Paddle
events.summary: Guided flatwater trip from Ledyard Bridge. Boats available to rent at the launch.

events.name: Norwich University Corps Parade
events.summary: Full dress review on the upper parade ground, open to the public.

events.name: Labor Day on the Common
events.summary: Chicken barbecue, a rooster-calling contest, and fireworks after dark.

events.name: Dog River Trail Run
events.summary: Six miles of singletrack along the river. Muddy in the low sections — wear the old shoes.

events.name: Barre Opera House: Vaudeville Revival
events.summary: An 1899 hall doing what it was built for — magic, tap, and a closing brass number.

events.name: Granite Carving Demonstration
events.summary: Watch a sculptor work a block of Barre gray with pneumatic tools. Ear protection provided.

events.name: Rock of Ages Quarry Tour
events.summary: Overlook tour of the deepest granite quarry on earth, plus the outdoor bowling lane cut from stone.

events.name: Paramount Theatre: Comedy Night
events.summary: Touring headliner in a restored 1913 house. Two openers, no phones.

events.name: Downtown Rutland Night Market
events.summary: Center Street closes to cars — makers, food carts, and a stage at the Merchants Row end.

events.name: Pine Hill Park Trail Day
events.summary: Volunteer trail maintenance across sixteen miles of hand-built singletrack, lunch included.

events.name: Northern Stage: Mainstage Opening
events.summary: Opening night of the fall season at the Barrette Center, with a reception after curtain.

venue.name: Barrette Center for the Arts
venue.address: 74 Gates St, White River Junction, VT

events.name: Main Street Museum Oddities Tour
events.summary: A cabinet of curiosities in an old firehouse. The curator tells the story behind every drawer.

venue.name: Main Street Museum
venue.address: 58 Bridge St, White River Junction, VT

events.name: Cartoon Studies Open Studio
events.summary: The Center for Cartoon Studies opens its bullpen — students showing pages in progress.

venue.name: Center for Cartoon Studies
venue.address: 46 S Main St, White River Junction, VT

events.name: Town Hall Theater: Opera Live
events.summary: Live simulcast from the Met, with intermission talks from a Middlebury music professor.

events.name: Otter Creek Falls Fall Festival
events.summary: Craft booths above the falls, apple pressing, and a chowder cook-off at the bridge.

events.name: Mahaney Arts Center: Jazz Quintet
events.summary: Faculty quintet playing Mingus arrangements in the recital hall.

events.name: Trail Around Middlebury Hike
events.summary: Guided section hike of the TAM, sixteen miles of loop trail circling the town.
